Experimental link template, which might reduce spam on pages linked to from high-traffic pages (especially the announcements).

==Usage==
This template accepts up to 10 (ordered) parameters, as well as an optional parameter for a displayed title (<code>t=</code>). Note that '''leading and trailing spaces are stripped from template arguments''' &mdash; that is, spaces in a parameter should have at least one non-whitespace character on each side.
<pre>{{link|Ma|in P|ag|e}}</pre>
{{link|Ma|in P|ag|e}}

<pre>{{link|Ma|in |Pag|e}}</pre>
{{link|Ma|in |Pag|e}} (trailing spaces are stripped from argument 2)

<pre>{{link|Ma|in P|ag|e|t=Link to main page}}</pre>
{{link|Ma|in P|ag|e|t=Link to main page}}

</noinclude>
